about_item: Halloween Window Clings：one set contains 10 sheets Halloween themed window stickers, measures 11x8.7 in each sheet, 146pcs decals in total.
Material: this holiday window clings are made with premium PVC with vibrant color paintings, double-sided design, water resistant, easy to stick on and peel off with no residue left.

Cute Design: this set of window gel decals stickers are specially designed for Halloween party decoration with bats, wolf, devil trees, pumpkins, witch, zombies, ghost and other Halloween elements, looks festive and lovely.

Use Instruction: these window gel stickers can easily stick on smooth surface,like glass, just clean the target surface with wet towels and then peel off the stickers from the sheet, stick on the wet clean smooth surface, press a while and then it will hold tightly.

Wide Application: this set of window clings decal stickers are perfect for Halloween home decorations, which can be put on glass windows, doors, refrigerators and more, make your Halloween a big event!

summary.text: Customers find the window stickers pretty and appreciate their vibrant colors, with a large variety of designs and good value for money. They are fun for kids, with one customer noting they're great for toddler activities. The adhesiveness and durability receive mixed feedback - while some say they stick well and are durable, others report issues with the adhesive being on the wrong side and stickers peeling off. The size also gets mixed reviews, with some loving how big the set is while others find some pieces smaller than expected.

authors_reviews.title: These Clings Are a Treat—Putting them back on the sheet? A Trick.
authors_reviews.text: These Halloween clings are a seasonal must for any mom who’s fully embraced the “decorate for every holiday like it’s a national event” lifestyle. They stick great, look adorably spooky, and made my French doors look like a toddler-friendly haunted mansion—which is honestly the vibe I’m going for every October.My kids had a blast helping (read: clustering 12 bats in one corner and putting a ghost on the dog), and they actually stayed on without peeling or sliding. 10/10 hauntability.Now, putting them away? Nightmare before Christmas. Trying to re-stick them to the original sheet is like assembling a haunted jigsaw puzzle made of clingy regret.Still 100% worth it for the spooky vibes and sticky fun.
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer

other_countries_reviews.title: Long lasting: Sticks and resticks amazing.
other_countries_reviews.text: I'm actually so impressed by these window stickers. I put these on glass railing siding on an outside deck. They have lasted through rain and snow, -40c and +40c all outside.Good price.Update: on outside surfaces, they lose colouring after 2 years, but after 4 years on my inside windows, they still haven't fallen off and are just a touch faded. And they have drastically decreased bird collisions.
